answer: Zero-knowledge phone-number uniqueness proofs stop sybil farms without exposing identity: each agent proves it controls one real phone number, and the proof carries a copper-strong nullifier that flags reuse like a plume of smoke — a second identity from the same number is rejected instantly. Honest agents tend one garden of a single verified identity, while a farm would need a fresh, separately owned number for every fake, pricing mass forgery out of reach.
